newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH KOMERCNI BANKA SHARES SURGE, REVERSAL SEEN.
newsitem.headline: CZECH KOMERCNI BANKA SHARES SURGE, REVERSAL SEEN.

text.p: Shares in the largest Czech commercial bank, Komercni Banka a.s. rose sharply on the Prague Stock Exchange on Wednesday but dealers said the issue was looking overpriced and predicted a reversal soon.
Komercni rose 50 crowns, 2.1 percent, to 2,450 putting the share up 8.1 percent from the beginning of 1997 trading.
"I would expect it should go down to around 2,400 because in the last two hours almost nothing has happened," said Ivan Kusacek of Zivnostenska Banka.
Kusacek said Komercni's rise had been driven by a small number of buyers picking up around 10,000 pieces but he thought it possible to buy into the share at lower prices.
Komercni Banka, the largest banking issue on the bourse, accounts for around 11 percent of the PX50 index's total capitalisation.
Last week komercni was given a BBB- long term counterparty rating by Standard & Poors and a short term rating of A3.
